name: @openlife-au/workspace
description: Open Life Data Standards (AU) — vendor-neutral contracts for Australian life insurance

scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:quoting && npm run bundle:policy
scripts.bundle:quoting: redocly bundle domains/quoting/openapi.yaml -o dist/quoting/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle domains/quoting/openapi.yaml -o dist/quoting/openapi.json
scripts.docs: redocly build-docs domains/quoting/openapi.yaml -o site/quoting/index.html && redocly build-docs domains/policy/openapi.yaml -o site/policy/index.html
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run bundle && npm run examples && npm run rejections && npm run provenance
scripts.codegen: for l in typescript python java ruby go csharp; do npm run codegen:$l || exit 1; done
scripts.bundle:policy: redocly bundle domains/policy/openapi.yaml -o dist/policy/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle domains/policy/openapi.yaml -o dist/policy/openapi.json
